name: TR-85M1 Bizonul
protection: Composite turret and hull add-on armour, steel side skirts, mine plate. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm can only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: T-55-like rounded turret enlarged with angular, triangular-profile add-on armour panels and a box bustle
Six road wheels per side with a noticeably larger gap behind the first two
Steel side skirts with three cut-out holes used as steps
DShK ammunition boxes on the turret sides; flare launchers
